participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

site.Description: Acquisition site, as coded by the source.

days_since_baseline.Description: Days from the baseline pre-operative scan.

os_days.Description: Overall survival: time to death if os_event = 1, else censoring time (target). For baseline sessions it is from surgery; for follow-up sessions the source measures it from the follow-up scan (about the baseline value minus days_since_baseline). Use the baseline session for survival tasks.

Levels.0: censored: alive, lost to follow-up, or deceased with an uncertain date

gross_total_resection.Description: More than 90% of the tumor resected.

psp_tp_score.Description: Pseudoprogression vs true progression score, 1-6 (follow-ups only).
